def: to breathe; passively, to be breathed upon , i.e. (figuratively) refreshed (as if by a current of air)

occurrences.text: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
